# openvicloud_volume_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a volume to a VM of the same cluster. Changing either side detaches and attaches again.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String)
- `volume_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The volume's id.
